We had a very terrible experience with Vidhya Hospital and Daya Hospital in Dindoshi, Goregaon, both managed by Dr. Sonali Mishra and Dr. Vikas Mishra. I strongly recommend avoiding these hospitals.

My wife suffered a miscarriage that was treated at this hospital, but the procedure was not done correctly, leaving her in severe abdominal pain just two days later. When we returned for a follow-up, they suggested that she might have Appendix and insisted on a sonography at Subodh Digital Imaging Clinic, run by Dr. Subodh Daptardar. When we inquired about the results, Dr. Subodh told us to wait outside, stating that he would inform Dr. Vikas directly. It was clear they were working together, likely to cover up their mistake.

They urged us to admit my wife immediately for supposed Appendix treatment, emphasizing the urgency and even questioning if we had Mediclaim coverage—a standard practice in many hospitals nowadays.

Sensing something was wrong, we sought a second opinion. We discovered that my wife did not have appendicitis at all.
